summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD joint press release (September 20, 2022) reporting new residential construction statistics for August 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 4a provides seasonally adjusted data for "New Privately-Owned Housing Units Under Construction at End of Period" disaggregated by region. For the South region, it records a total of 791 thousand units for August 2022 (marked as preliminary). This document supplies the initial data point for the requested 2022/08 start window, though it does not cover the period beyond August 2022 or include publicly-owned units.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release titled "New Residential Construction, September 2022" (Release CB22-174), published October 19, 2022. Regarding the task: Table 4a provides seasonally adjusted estimates for "New Privately-Owned Housing Units Under Construction at End of Period" by region. For the South region, the table lists the total count in thousands for August 2022 as 794 (revised) and September 2022 as 794 (preliminary). This document contributes the initial two months of the required 2022/08 to 2025/05 timeframe but does not contain data for 2023–2025. While the task requests "total housing units," this release specifies "privately-owned" units, which is the relevant available metric for the "Under Construction" metric in this document.
